_comment: Sn-beta glucose C2->C1 hydride transfer on Tian's RECONSTRUCTED 42-atom vacuum cluster (tt-test commit b97ef46). NOT literature coordinates and NOT authoritative: see input/tian_tt_test/provenance.json. Charge 0 / multiplicity 1 are inferred model choices. Atom indices are ZERO-BASED and identical in reactant and product. config.json remains the (unconfigured) slot for authoritative structures.

provenance.construction_method: RDKit build + geometric Sn-site placement, relaxed with MACE-POLAR-1-S (glucose/structures/scripts/)
provenance._comment: structure_class 'reconstructed' => stages print a provenance banner, every result JSON carries this block, and run_path refuses --allow-unoptimized (endpoints must be validated AND relaxed with the method in use first).

system.label: Sn-beta / glucose C2->C1 hydride transfer -- RECONSTRUCTED vacuum cluster (Tian, tt-test)
system._charge_comment: Inferred model choice (Tian), consistent with Sn(IV) + 4 anionic O and 230 electrons; NOT literature-confirmed.

_atom_map_comment: Copied from Tian's atom_map.json (checked equal by tests). C1 = aldehyde carbon (acceptor); C2 = donor; H_transfer = H* on C2 in the reactant; O_water = O of the Sn-bound water.
_fixed_atoms_comment: Tian froze nothing; kept for comparability. The SiH3 caps therefore relax freely (they rotate between conformers -- see conformer diagnostics).

capping._comment: Each cap is O-SiH3 with the O bound to Sn. Checked by validate_structure._check_caps (errors).

sn_site.source: Our reading of Ali 2025 thesis Fig. 4.1b/c (adapted from Mushrif et al. 2015 Fig. 1). Diagnostic warnings only.

CV1.status: Same as config.json: atoms from thesis Fig. 4.1c; r0/n/m are PLACEHOLDERS.

CV2.status: Same as config.json: atoms from thesis Fig. 4.1c; r0/n/m are PLACEHOLDERS.

reference_basins.source: As config.json (Ali 2025 thesis Sec. 4.2). DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not interpretable while CV parameters are unconfirmed.

_protocol_comment: Common protocol for all three methods. Endpoint fmax 0.02 and Sella internal/1e-3 match Tian's POLAR run so his numbers can be reproduced; NEB settings are the repository defaults (13 images, CI, k=0.5).
